VU0_S2_VCLIPw emits ps2_vu_clip: integer compare, w with exp 0 forced to 0x007fffff, bit0 0x01 x>+|w|, bit1 0x02 x<-|w|, y 0x04/0x08, z 0x10/0x20, (clip<<6)|flags & 0xFFFFFF. Field broadcast kept.

fix.change: CVT.W.S chop toward 0 with EE saturation. Kind COP1_S_CVT_W, emitter text unchanged.
42 FMAC translators call ps2_vu_mac_apply and replace vu0_status. Kinds listed in facts. VOPMULA/VOPMSUB mask 0xE and do not clear W.

contra: MAC O/U/Z are computed on the value PS2_VADD/VSUB/VMUL already stored. Exp0 is flushed to signed 0 first, so a denormal lane becomes S|Z and not U. A value already clamped to 0x7FFFFFFF does not raise O.
vu0_status is replaced, not OR'd. The 3 CFC2.STATUS sites, two of them after CTC2 status plus VSUBs, will see the VSUB summary instead of the CTC2 value. microVU status is sticky.
fd==0 still writes vf[0]. Audit .text count of those writes is 0.
Exp255 stays a finite exponent in PS2_VADD. CVT.W.S still saturates exp 255. SQRT/RSQRT sign model was not flipped.
Macro VCLIP uses the integer compare. VU1 clipOp stays the float fabs compare. They differ on denormals.
Flags are written immediately. The four CFC2.MAC sites are 1-5 instructions later, so that is what those reads need. A 4-cycle delay is not modeled.
-2^31-1 is not a float32. The CVT test uses -2^31 and the next more-negative float 0xCF000001.
